notes.title: 🌍 LOCALIZATION UPDATE – The Wallway now speaks your language! 🗣️
notes.notes:
🌍 LOCALIZATION UPDATE 🌍🎮 Early Access – Beta 1.0.85.1 🎮
We're thrilled to announce a major language expansion in The Wallway! 🛠️🌐

With this update, you can now play the game in 10 new languages:


🇬🇧 ✔️ English (existing)

🇨🇳 ✔️ Chinese (Simplified)

🇨🇿 ✔️ Czech

🇫🇷 ✔️ French

🇩🇪 ✔️ German

🇯🇵 ✔️ Japanese

🇧🇷 ✔️ Portuguese (Brazil)

🇷🇺 ✔️ Russian

🇪🇸 ✔️ Spanish

🇹🇷 ✔️ Turkish

🇺🇦 ✔️ Ukrainian

We're entering a new global phase for the game – more players, more screams, more survival. 🧟‍♂️

please note that some translations may be incomplete or contain minor issues – we are actively improving them.

Thank you for supporting The Wallway! 🎁

– 🪐 Galactic Games Team

notes.title: Patch 1.0.5 – Map & Mechanics Overhaul
notes.notes:
This update brings several gameplay and atmosphere improvements to The Wallway, focusing on player interaction, map clarity, and new gameplay elements.

🗺️ Map Adjustments – Updated layout and environmental tweaks for smoother navigation.
🖐️ Object Interaction Tweaks – More responsive and intuitive object handling.
🌫️ Reduced Visual Effects – Lowered some visual effects for better clarity and performance.
⚙️ Object System Tuning – Optimized behaviors and interactions of specific objects.
🔊 New Sound Effects – Added immersive sound cues to enhance tension and realism.
☠️ Skeleton Kill System – You can now eliminate skeletons under certain conditions.
🏆 New Achievement – “And he’s gone...” has been added. Can you unlock it?

More content and improvements are on the way — thank you for playing The Wallway!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4 – Design & Network Fixes
notes.notes:
This patch brings a mix of design improvements and better network performance to enhance your co-op horror experience in The Wallway.

🎨 Design Bug Fixes – Corrected visual and layout issues affecting gameplay immersion.
🌐 Network Transmission Tuning – Improved data transfer between clients for smoother sessions.
🔧 Minor Adjustments – Small internal changes to support stability and performance.

Thank you for your support – more updates coming soon!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1: Hit & Chase Fix
notes.notes:
This minor update brings important improvements to both the monster’s behavior and the multiplayer experience.

What’s included:

💀 Monster Hit Fix – Resolved an issue where the monster's attack didn't register properly in certain cases.
🛠️ Multiplayer Tuning – Improved overall stability and synchronization in online sessions.
💀 Monster Chase Fix – Adjusted monster AI to better handle chase logic and target switching.

Thanks for playing The Wallway — more updates are on the way!
